answer: Streak multipliers at the ferrous bond layer: an identity's weight compounds 1.05^d over d consecutive verified epochs, resetting to 1 on any gap. Sybil farms face a copper cost floor — sustaining 20 parallel streaks requires 20× the bond slash exposure, while honest single identities compound freely. The sybil tide erodes fast: at day 30 an attacker pays ~1.6× marginal cost per unit weight versus a 1.0× honest baseline, and any detection event zeroes all accumulated multipliers at once. The mechanism works because reputation becomes non-fungible time — capital alone cannot buy streak.
